# Laura Abreu Therapy

> Laura Abreu, LCSW is a bilingual (English/Spanish) licensed therapist offering virtual therapy for millennial women in Florida, New Jersey, and Vermont. She specializes in anxiety, breakup and heartbreak recovery, maternal mental health (perinatal and postpartum), trauma, and life transitions. All sessions are conducted online via secure telehealth.

## About

- [About Laura Abreu, LCSW](https://www.lauraabreutherapy.com/pages/about.html): Background, therapeutic approach, and licensing across FL (SW19049), NJ (44SC06498200), and VT (089.0134777TELE).
- [Fees and Insurance](https://www.lauraabreutherapy.com/pages/fees.html): Session fees, sliding scale availability, and accepted insurance plans.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.lauraabreutherapy.com/pages/faq.html): What to expect from therapy, session logistics, and insurance questions.

## Specialties

- [Anxiety Therapy](https://www.lauraabreutherapy.com/pages/anxiety.html): Online treatment for generalized anxiety, social anxiety, and panic.
- [Trauma Therapy](https://www.lauraabreutherapy.com/pages/trauma-therapy.html): Trauma-informed care for processing past experiences and PTSD symptoms.
- [DBT Therapy](https://www.lauraabreutherapy.com/pages/dbt-therapy.html): Dialectical Behavior Therapy for emotion regulation and interpersonal skills.
- [Maternal Mental Health](https://www.lauraabreutherapy.com/pages/maternal-mental-health.html): Perinatal and postpartum support including postpartum anxiety and depression.
- [Relationship Issues and Heartbreak](https://www.lauraabreutherapy.com/pages/relationship-issues.html): Breakup recovery, dating patterns, and emotionally unavailable partners.
- [Life Transitions](https://www.lauraabreutherapy.com/pages/life-transitions.html): Career changes, identity shifts, and major life pivots.
- [Therapy for Millennial Women](https://www.lauraabreutherapy.com/pages/millennial-women-mental-health.html): Therapy tailored to the unique pressures facing women in their late 20s to early 40s.
- [All Specialties Overview](https://www.lauraabreutherapy.com/pages/specialties.html): Complete list of therapy specialties and approaches.
